text:
ITEM 1 | Square white plate, roughly 26 cm across, used as the scale reference; the meal fills the center-right portion of it | 0
ITEM 2 | Cooked meat pieces, pale tan to grey-brown with browned edges, irregular bite-sized chunks about 2-3 cm each, slightly glossy and moist-looking, clustered on the left-center of the plate | 120
ITEM 3 | Pale cooked rice, off-white to light cream grains, loose and separate with some clumps, scattered among the meat and vegetables on the left-center of the plate, covering roughly 40 sq cm | 90
ITEM 4 | Zucchini or squash slices, pale green skin with yellowish flesh, two rounded slices about 4-5 cm across and 0.5-1 cm thick, soft and slightly wilted, at the upper left edge of the meal | 35
ITEM 5 | Green asparagus spears, bright to dark green, straight, about 1 cm thick and 10-12 cm long, around 8 spears laid diagonally across the center of the plate, firm with slightly fibrous surface | 45
ITEM 6 | Mixed salad greens, including crisp pale green lettuce leaves with ruffled edges and darker green spinach-like leaves, glossy and slightly moist, covering roughly one quarter of the plate on the right side | 60
ITEM 7 | Cherry tomato half, deep red with glossy skin and light seed interior, about 3 cm across, sitting on the upper right of the salad | 15
ITEM 8 | Diced yellow and orange fruit pieces, small cubes about 1 cm, slightly translucent with a moist sheen, clustered beside the tomato on the salad | 10
ITEM 9 | Shredded orange carrot pieces, thin bright orange strips about 3-4 cm long, scattered within the dark greens on the right edge | 3
ITEM 10 | Browned cooked fragments, small dark brown bits with crisp edges, a few scattered near the meat and rice | 5
